mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO kb_clause (document_id, clause_ref, clause_no, parent_no, path, title, body, layer, levels, clause_type, ordinal, body_sha256) VALUES
(#{documentId}, #{c.clauseRef}, #{c.clauseNo}, #{c.parentNo}, #{c.path}, #{c.title}, #{c.body}, #{c.layer}, #{c.levels}, #{c.clauseType}, #{c.ordinal}, #{c.bodySha256})
mapper.delete: DELETE c FROM kb_clause c JOIN kb_document d ON c.document_id = d.id WHERE d.doc_code = #{docCode}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM kb_clause c JOIN kb_document d ON c.document_id = d.id WHERE c.clause_ref IN #{ref}
SELECT FROM kb_clause c JOIN kb_document d ON c.document_id = d.id WHERE d.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY d.id, c.ordinal
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_clause c JOIN kb_document d ON c.document_id = d.id WHERE d.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.sql: FROM kb_clause c JOIN kb_document d ON c.document_id = d.id WHERE d.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.layer = #{layer} AND FIND_IN_SET(#{level}, c.levels) > 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM kb_clause c JOIN kb_document d ON c.document_id = d.id WHERE d.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.clause_type = '要求' AND c.layer = #{layer} AND FIND_IN_SET(#{level}, c.levels) > 0 ORDER BY d.id, c.ordinal
